name: DSH2Forsion
description: 在 Forsion 里常驻一个 DeepSeek Harness：DSH 这个 Agent 的对话连它，DSH 工作台开它自己的界面，在工作台里装 DSH 插件前先体检。完整能力需要新版 Forsion。兼容 DeepSeek Harness，非 DeepSeek 官方出品。
descriptionEn: Keeps one DeepSeek Harness running in Forsion: chats with the DSH agent connect to it, the DSH workbench opens its own interface, and DSH plugins installed there are checked first. Full support requires an updated Forsion. Compatible with DeepSeek Harness; not made or endorsed by DeepSeek.

onboarding.intro: 第一次使用会下载兼容运行时（约 1.1 GB 磁盘）。DSH 用你自己的 DSH 目录，另用一份名叫 forsion 的组合。

steps.title: 准备运行时
steps.description: 在 DSH 这个 Agent 的 Harness 卡上点「打开工作台」。第一次会说明下载内容与来源，你点击后才开始。

steps.title: 在工作台里装插件
steps.description: 用 DSH 自己的「插件」页安装。装之前先在临时目录里试启动，报告它加了什么，你点「装」才继续。

steps.title: 和 DSH 对话
steps.description: Forsion 里和 DSH 这个 Agent 的对话连的就是工作台里那个 DSH：右键对话可以在工作台里接着看。

en.intro: First use downloads the compatibility runtime (about 1.1 GB of disk). DSH uses your own DSH folder with a separate profile named forsion.

steps.title: Prepare the runtime
steps.description: Press Open workbench on the Harness card of the DSH agent. First use explains the download and its source, and starts only when you click.

steps.title: Install plugins in the workbench
steps.description: Use DSH's own Plugins page. Each plugin is first started in a scratch folder and you see what it adds; it is installed only when you press Install.

steps.title: Chat with DSH
steps.description: Chats with the DSH agent in Forsion connect to the same DSH as the workbench: right-click a conversation to follow it there.
